title: Methods
explanation: A method is a named, reusable block of code. It can take parameters (inputs) and optionally return a value.
Shape: static returnType name(paramType paramName, ...) { ... return value; }  Use 'void' as the return type if it doesn't return anything.
Methods are how you avoid repeating yourself -- write the logic once, call it as many times as you like with different inputs.
